summary: A member speaks to the chamber when taking a position during floor debate.
realLife: During the July 2017 health care debate, Senator Maggie Hassan urged colleagues to oppose taking up the measure. From the floor she asked for hearings where the public could describe what changes would mean for them.
inGame: The floor-debate situation and floor-debate-facts.ts provide the occasion and bill.
gates: The chamber is debating the bill.

turns.what: The member speaks after the amendment is read into the record.
turns.pulledBy: Their position depends on which version is before the chamber.
turns.writesBack: The remark is attached to debate on the amended bill.

turns.what: The member supports a hearing on the bill and declines to promise the sponsor a vote on passage.
turns.pulledBy: The floor question concerns taking up the measure, and the member has asked to hear from affected residents.
turns.writesBack: The whip’s notes record a position on debate and leave final passage open.
